why: Searches turned up only variant/extension work post-snapshot: progress toward Keating-Snaith for quadratic twists of elliptic curves, a conditional lower bound for cubic Hecke L-functions over the Eisenstein field (arXiv 2511.08783), and integer-moment/derivative-moment extensions (arXiv 2509.07792) — none of these settle a case of, or improve a bound on, the original conjecture's own quantity (the moments of |zeta(1/2+it)|^2k for general integer k, still proven only for k=1,2). No proof, disproof, or new case of the zeta-moment conjecture itself was found.
queries: Keating-Snaith conjecture moments Riemann zeta function arXiv 2025

found.title: Towards Keating-Snaith's conjecture for cubic Hecke L-functions over the Eisenstein field
found.note: Preprint on a related family of L-functions (Hecke L-functions), a different family than the Riemann zeta function.

found.title: Integer moments of the derivatives of the Riemann zeta function
found.note: Preprint on moments of derivatives of zeta, an extension of the moment problem rather than the stated conjecture.

found.title: Progress towards the Keating-Snaith conjecture for quadratic twists of elliptic curves
found.note: Seminar/announcement page on a variant of the conjecture for a family of elliptic curve L-functions, not the zeta function.
